notes.title: 🛠️ Bug Fixes Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
I just released an update that fixes some bugs and issues in the game.

A big thank you to everyone who reported problems!
Feel free to reach out if you find anything else or have suggestions.

Have fun and see you in-game!

— Deb

notes.title: ILLUSTRATIONS IN THE DIALOGUES AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone, [i]fake duckies[/i]! [/h1]

[h3]From today you will find a great new feature: the presence of[b] illustrations during dialogues[/b]![/h3]

That's right! This is an addition to the game experience in which, during dialogues precisely, in the most important scenes will be shown the illustrations of the characters with the purpose of becoming more familiar, not only with the story, but with the characters themselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173063/0d194e74a8036dbf30549adca80a03febb0effce.png[/img]

I had a lot of fun drawing all of these scenes, from the most serious to the funniest, so I hope you can really enjoy this addition that I really care about!

[h3][i]Don't forget to leave a review if you are enjoying the game, 
but most importantly... Keep up the fun![/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173063/32f2d14e8fa15f485147de95a9b7031f8f3d7fa6.png[/img]

notes.title: Christmas event over... But lots of NEW THINGS COMING UP!
notes.notes:
Hey, players of Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles! 👋

I hope you had a blast battling monstrous gifts, facing off against a "special" Santa, and winning the hearts of the Fake Ducks during the Christmas event! 🎅✨ But now that our holiday event has come to a close, don’t get too nostalgic... because the best is yet to come! 🚀

🎁 What’s just around the corner? The Fake Ducklings aren’t just resting from the festivities—they’re sharpening their skills and preparing a ton of AMAZING new stuff to make your gameplay even more fun and spooky! 🦆💥
New features? Exclusive content? Unexpected surprises? Just one word: Yes. 😉

⚡ Spoiler Alert: This will be the best excuse to NEVER stop playing. 💻🎮

So, get ready to sharpen your reflexes, invite your friends, and keep exploring the world of Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles! We need your enthusiasm, your cleverness, and, of course, all your fun energy to make this game legendary. 🦆👑

Stay tuned for updates, and remember: the Fake Ducks might be "fake," but the fun is more real than ever!

See you in the game, champs! – Your Deb from Fake Ducks

notes.title: Christmas Event Now Live! 🎄
notes.notes:
Hello, fearless Fake Duckers! 🦆

Christmas has arrived in the world of Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles! 🎁 The Christmas Event free update is now live, bringing festive cheer… with a spooky twist! Here’s what’s waiting for you:

🎄 Decorated Laboratory
Our beloved lab is all decked out for the holidays! Twinkling lights, Christmas trees, and a cozy atmosphere await as you prepare for your next mission.

🧙‍♂️ Headville Level Decorated
Headville has never looked so festive! From streets to rooftops, you’ll find Christmas decorations everywhere. But don’t let the festive charm distract you too much, because…

🎅 Exclusive New Mission in "Headville"
Embark on a special Christmas-themed mission, where:

New exclusive monsters will try to get in your way.
You might bump into a certain bearded fellow... (Spoiler: he doesn’t just bring gifts!).
Don’t wait—jump into the game now and experience our spooky holiday spirit! ❄️ Let’s celebrate the season Fake Ducks style!

📣 Note: The event will only be available for a limited time, so don’t miss out!

See you in Headville!

notes.title: END OF HALLOWEEN EVENT! BACK TO “NORMALITY”
notes.notes:
Hello all Fake Duckers! 
As announced, as of today the two-week-long [b]Halloween event comes to an end[/b] and it's back to normal on “[i]Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles[/i]”.

But this should not demoralize you! 
Because also included with this patch are some [i]changes [/i]that bring changes to [b]combat management[/b].

In fact, the controls for skill selection have been simplified and some features, which are not only unnecessary, but also annoying, have been disabled!

[i]I hope you are enjoying the game!
Until the next patch![/i]

notes.title: 🎃 Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles - Halloween Update 🎃
notes.notes:
[h3]Get ready for a spooky and fun event in Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles! The free Halloween update is available from October 21 to November 4, and it brings some eerie surprises. [/h3]
Here’s what you can expect:

[b]- Halloween-themed Lab:[/b] The lab has been completely transformed with Halloween decorations.

[b]- Exclusive Mission in Monterock:[/b] Get ready for a spooky adventure with the exclusive Monterock mission. You’ll come face to face with some cute but mischievous animated pumpkins—they might look adorable... until they show their bad side! Overcome the challenges and uncover the hidden secrets in this haunted level.

[b]- Final Showdown with Special Boss:[/b] At the end of the mission, take on a unique Halloween boss that will test your skills. Defeat it, and you’ll be rewarded with exclusive items available only during this special event!

[h3]Don’t miss out on the chance to experience the terror and fun in Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles during this limited-time update. Gather your Fake Ducks and get ready for the spookiest adventure of the year![/h3]

notes.title: FULL SCREEN PATCH
notes.notes:
I have just implemented a feature to improve changing the game window to full screen: simply press F5 and the window will be adapted to your screen, also pressing F6 will change the screen ratio instead.
Thank you for the feedback and I remain available for any other advice or needs! :)
